name: 20639 · Huntingtown, MD
findings: ZIP 20639 (Huntingtown) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20639 (Huntingtown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 20639 (Huntingtown) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).
